meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 当你搜索科学论文时，Claude会调用BGPT MCP服务器，返回结构化实验数据（方法、结果、样本量等）而非仅摘要。
howto.when: 当你需要搜索包含实验细节、定量结果或质量评分的科学论文时触发。也可用于系统综述或证据综合。

say.text: 搜索关于CRISPR基因编辑效率的论文，返回实验方法。
say.note: 返回结构化论文数据，含样本量和结果。

say.text: 帮我找比较不同疗法效果的研究，并给出质量评分。
say.note: 返回含质量评估的论文列表。

say.text: 我需要最近五年关于AI在医学诊断中的应用的文献。
say.note: 按关键词搜索并返回结构化摘要。

howto.what_en: When you search for scientific papers, Claude calls the BGPT MCP server to return structured experimental data (methods, results, sample sizes, etc.) instead of just abstracts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need scientific papers with experimental details, quantitative results, or quality scores. Also for systematic reviews or evidence synthesis.

say_en.text: Search for papers on CRISPR gene editing efficiency and return experimental methods.
say_en.note: Returns structured paper data including sample sizes and results.

say_en.text: Find studies comparing different therapies and give quality scores.
say_en.note: Returns paper list with quality assessments.

say_en.text: I need literature on AI in medical diagnosis from the last five years.
say_en.note: Searches by keywords and returns structured abstracts.
